sources.verified_excerpt: TASK_LOGON_PASSWORD: password must be supplied at registration time. TASK_LOGON_S4U: no password is stored, and there is no access to either the network or encrypted files.
Tasks registered with TASK_LOGON_PASSWORD or TASK_LOGON_S4U only launch if the specified user has Logon as Batch privilege enabled.
